name: Workspace
description:
## Summary

1. **Initial problem:** `https://gbrian.codxjunior.com/workspace-default/coder` returned the codx-junior SPA instead of VSCodium.
2. **Root cause found:** the running coder container still had stale single-router labels (TLS-only, no `entrypoints`), so traffic on Traefik's plain-HTTP `web` entrypoint fell through to the catch-all `codx-junior@docker` router (priority 29 vs. coder's 71).
3. **First fix:** split the coder router into explicit `web` (HTTP, no TLS) and `websecure` (HTTPS + certresolver) routers sharing one service, both protected by `codx-junior-auth`; recreating the container applied it and the VSCodium page then loaded.
4. **New symptom:** the workbench WebSocket closed with `1006` — Traefik reached `serve-web` and the upgrade was answered, but TLS terminates in an upstream proxy, so `serve-web` received `X-Forwarded-Proto: http`/`ws` on a page loaded over HTTPS.
5. **Second fix (pending apply):** added a `coder-headers` middleware (`X-Forwarded-Proto=https`, `X-Forwarded-Port=443`) wired through a `coder-chain` on both routers, plus explicit `loadbalancer.server.scheme=http`, mirroring the working `preview` route.

"""
WorkspaceManager — docker-compose based workspace lifecycle manager.

Each workspace lives in its own subdirectory under CODX_JUNIOR_WORKSPACES_FOLDER:

    <workspaces_root>/<workspace.folder_path>/
        docker-compose.yaml   ← user-managed, defines all services
        .env                  ← optional, injected into compose
        Dockerfile            ← optional, if building custom images
        ...

Traefik integration
-------------------
Services in docker-compose.yaml must declare Traefik labels themselves
OR use external URLs which are handled by the HTTP provider in traefik.py.

For container-port apps, users add labels like:
    - "traefik.enable=true"
    - "traefik.http.routers.<id>.rule=PathPrefix(`/ws/<slug>/<app>`)"
    - "traefik.http.services.<id>.loadbalancer.server.port=<port>"

This manager exposes helpers to inject those labels automatically when
workspace.apps is populated and the service name matches the app.

        """Absolute path to the workspace folder."""
        return (self.workspaces_root / workspace.folder_path).resolve()

    def compose_file(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:
        return self.workspace_dir(workspace) / "docker-compose.yaml"

    def ensure_dir(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:

        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return d

    def destroy(self, workspace: Workspace) -> None:
        """Remove the workspace directory entirely."""
        d = self.workspace_dir(workspace)
        if d.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(d)
            logger.info("Removed workspace directory: %s", d)

        D --> E[Filter app.roles per workspace]

    global_settings = read_global_settings()

        if user_has_workspace_access(user, w)

                if not app.roles or user.role in app.roles
            ]

        "User '%s' (role=%s) can access %d of %d workspaces",
        user.username if user else "anonymous",
        user.role if user else "none",
        len(accessible),
        len(global_settings.workspaces),
    )

# VSCodium

VSCodium is a community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of Microsoft’s editor VS Code.

![Screenshot](https://vscodium.com/img/vscodium.png)

## Why Does This Exist

Microsoft’s `vscode` source code is open source (MIT-licensed), but the product available for download (Visual Studio Code) is licensed under [this not-FLOSS license](https://code.visualstudio.com/license) and contains telemetry/tracking. According to [this comment](https://github.com/Microsoft/vscode/issues/60#issuecomment-161792005) from a Visual Studio Code maintainer:

> When we [Microsoft] build Visual Studio Code, we do exactly this. We clone the vscode repository, we lay down a customized product.json that has Microsoft specific functionality (telemetry, gallery, logo, etc.), and then produce a build that we release under our license.
> 
> When you clone and build from the vscode repo, none of these endpoints are configured in the default product.json. Therefore, you generate a “clean” build, without the Microsoft customizations, which is by default licensed under the MIT license

The VSCodium project exists so that you don’t have to download+build from source. This project includes special build scripts that clone Microsoft’s vscode repo, run the build commands, and upload the resulting binaries for you to [GitHub releases](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/releases). **These binaries are licensed under the MIT license. Telemetry is disabled.**

If you want to build from source yourself, head over to [Microsoft’s vscode repo](https://github.com/Microsoft/vscode) and follow their [instructions](https://github.com/Microsoft/vscode/wiki/How-to-Contribute#build-and-run). VSCodium exists to make it easier to get the latest version of MIT-licensed VS Code.

messages.content: Attached docker-compose file works, but we want to change the shared desktop to be multiuser and use vscodium instead coder

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking

**Core requirements**
- Replace the current `ghcr.io/linuxserver/webtop:debian-kde` desktop with `kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop` (KasmVNC).
- Make the desktop **multiuser** (not one shared session).
- Replace the **coder / code-server** endpoint with **VSCodium** (https://vscodium.com).
- Keep the existing Traefik + `codx-junior-auth` routing model intact.

**What exists today (verified on disk)**

| Item | Path | State |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Desktop compose | `../codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/docker-compose.workspace-default.yaml` | 2 services: `codx-junior-default` (webtop, 3000 + 9080) and `codx-junior-docs` |
| Env | `.../codx-junior-workspace-default/.workspace.env` | `USER_ID`, `GROUP_ID`, `CODE_SERVER_PORT=9080` |
| Dockerfile | `.../codx-junior-workspace-default/Dockerfile` | `FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/webtop:debian-kde`, `EXPOSE 9080` |
| Default app list | `api/codx/junior/model/workspace.py` → `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE` | apps: `Coder` (`/workspace-default/coder/`), `Desktop` (`/workspace-default/preview/index.html`), `LiteLLM`, `Traefik` — all `roles: ["admin"]` |
| Workspace engine | `api/codx/junior/workspaces/engines/compose.py` | expects `docker-compose.yaml`; labels are generated per `WorkspaceApp` (`path`, `port`, `scheme`, `is_vnc` already support `scheme: https` for Kasm VNC) |

**Multiuser: what the Kasm image actually supports**
- `kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop` is **one X session per container**, streamed by KasmVNC on `https://<host>:6901`, user `kasm_user`, password from `VNC_PW`.
- KasmVNC allows **several concurrent viewers of the same session** (`user_session.concurrent_connections_prompt: false`, `new_session_disconnects_existing_exclusive_session: false` are the defaults) — that is a *shared* desktop, not isolated users.
- It has **no per-user session manager**. Isolated per-user desktops are exactly what the Kasm Workspaces orchestrator does: **one container per user session**.
- VSCodium has **no browser/server edition**, so the `/workspace-default/coder/` (code-server) route cannot be "re-pointed" to Codium — VSCodium must run *inside* the desktop.

**Options for "multiuser"**

| Option | Meaning | Cost | Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **A — per-user containers** | Each codx-junior user gets own container + own KasmVNC session at `/workspace-default/desktop/<user>` | New lazy provisioner in `codx/junior/workspaces/` + `WorkspaceApp.per_user` + URL resolution in UI | True isolation; needs API change |
| **B — one container, many concurrent users** | Same desktop, several users connected at once (KasmVNC default) | Compose only + remove `roles: ["admin"]` | Zero isolation; mouse/clipboard shared |
| **C — fixed replica pool** | `desktop-1..N` services in compose | Compose only | Ugly, static user↔slot mapping; not recommended |

**Dependencies & risks**
- KasmVNC serves a **self-signed HTTPS cert on 6901** → Traefik needs `scheme=https` **and** a `serversTransport` with `insecureSkipVerify`.
- `/api/code-server/file/open` → `CODXJuniorSession.coder_open_file()` runs `code-server -r` **inside the codx-junior API container**, so it keeps working but will no longer open files in the user's IDE unless we add a bridge in the desktop container.
- `docker.sock` is mounted in the workspace container today — required by Option A, unavoidable risk.
- Removing the `codx-junior-config` volume (linuxserver `/config`) orphans existing data; VSCodium settings/extensions get new volumes instead.

**Target files (Phase 1 — required for every option)**

| File | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `.../codx-junior-workspace-default/Dockerfile` | Rewrite: Kasm Noble base + VSCodium |
| `.../codx-junior-workspace-default/docker-compose.workspace-default.yaml` | Rewrite desktop service, drop coder router |
| `.../codx-junior-workspace-default/.workspace.env` | `VNC_PW` / `VNC_RESOLUTION`, drop `CODE_SERVER_PORT` |
| `api/codx/junior/model/workspace.py` | `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE`: remove `Coder` app (dead route) |

---

## 2. Open decisions (blocking Phase 2 only)

1. **Multiuser semantics**: Option **A** (per-user isolated containers, recommended) or **B** (single desktop, concurrent users)?
2. If **A**: provisioning trigger `lazy on first click` + idle shutdown (`kasmvnc.yaml auto_shutdown.inactive_user_session_timeout`)? Max concurrent desktops? Per-user KasmVNC password or rely on `codx-junior-auth`?
3. Keep `code-server` inside codx-junior for `/api/code-server/file/open`, or should I add an HTTP bridge in the desktop container (`DISPLAY=:1 codium --no-sandbox <file>`) so "open file" lands in VSCodium?
4. Kasm tag: pin `1.18.0` (used below) or track `1.18.0-rolling`?

---

## 3. Minimum Changes — Phase 1

### 3.1 Dockerfile

<file_change path="codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/Dockerfile" language="dockerfile" change_type="update" encoding="text">
################################################################################
# codx-junior default workspace desktop
#
# Base: kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop — Ubuntu 24.04 desktop streamed by KasmVNC
#       on https://<container>:6901 (user: kasm_user, password: $VNC_PW)
# Adds: VSCodium (https://vscodium.com) from the official apt repository, wired
#       into kasm_user's desktop and started with the session.
#
# Build:
#   docker compose build codx-junior-default
################################################################################
ARG KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE=kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0
FROM ${KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE}

USER root
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]

################################################################################
# VSCodium — official apt repository
# https://vscodium.com/#install-on-debian-ubuntu-debian-derivatives
################################################################################
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg \
    && curl -fsSL https://gitlab.com/paulcarroty/vscodium-deb-rpm-repo/raw/master/pub.gpg \
        | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg \
    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.vscodium.com/debs vscodium main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.list \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends codium \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

################################################################################
# Desktop integration for kasm-user (uid 1000)
#
# --no-sandbox: Electron/Chromium user namespaces are not available in the
# container, the flag is required for VSCodium to start.
################################################################################
RUN printf '%s\n' \
      '[Desktop Entry]' \
      'Type=Application' \
      'Name=VSCodium' \
      'GenericName=Text Editor' \
      'Comment=Code editing. Redefined. (VSCodium)' \
      'Exec=/usr/bin/codium --no-sandbox %F' \
      'Icon=vscodium' \
      'Terminal=false' \
      'Categories=Development;IDE;TextEditor;' \
      'StartupNotify=false' \
      'StartupWMClass=VSCodium' \
      > /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop \
    && mkdir -p /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss/extensions \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && chmod +x /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart/vscodium.desktop \
    && chown -R 1000:0 /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                     /home/kasm-user/.config \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss

# KasmVNC web endpoint (https)
EXPOSE 6901
</file_change>

| File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `.../codx-junior-workspace-default/Dockerfile` | Modify | base image | `webtop:debian-kde` → `kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0` (overridable via `--build-arg KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE`) |
| same | Modify | VSCodium | Installed from `download.vscodium.com` apt repo (`codium`) |
| same | Modify | desktop integration | `.desktop` launcher + autostart entry for `kasm_user`, `--no-sandbox`, writable config dirs for named volumes |
| same | Modify | expose | `9080` (code-server) → `6901` (KasmVNC) |

### 3.2 docker-compose.workspace-default.yaml

# kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop repository overview

**Kasm Workspaces is a docker container streaming platform for delivering browser-based access to desktops, applications, and web services.**

### [⁠](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop#live-demo)Live Demo

[![](https://info.kasm.com/hubfs/dockerhub/GIFs/ubuntu-jammy-desktop.gif)](https://app.kasm.com/#/cast/6708319219)

**Launch a real-time demo in a new browser window:** [Live Demo⁠](https://app.kasm.com/#/cast/6708319219).

[![](https://5856039.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hub/5856039/hubfs/dockerhub/casting-buttons/UbuntuJammyDesktop.png)](https://app.kasm.com/#/cast/6708319219)

∗ _Note: Demo is limited to 3 minutes and has upload/downloads restricted for security purposes._

### [⁠](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop#get-started)Get Started

Try out our no-cost Community Edition: [Download⁠](https://kasm.com/downloads).

Our Kasm Workspaces team has open-sourced our library of images ([Info⁠](https://docs.kasm.com/docs/how-to/workspaces-sessions/container-workspace/custom-images) & [Source Code⁠](https://github.com/kasmtech/workspaces-images)).

The web-native rendering is powered by our open-source project: [KasmVNC⁠](https://github.com/kasmtech/KasmVNC).

### [⁠](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop#about-this-image)About This Image

This Image contains a browser-accessible Ubuntu Noble Desktop with various productivity and development apps installed.

![Screenshot](https://5856039.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/5856039/dockerhub/image-screenshots/ubuntu_jammy_desktop.png)

This image contains the Signal app pre-installed. Signal enforces strict security rules that block network access if it detects SSL inspection (MitM). To ensure Signal functions correctly when **WebFilter** is enabled, you must add these domains to the **SSL Bypass Domains** list in your **WebFilter configuration** : (Notice the preceding dot (.) that ensures all subdomains are also bypassed)
    
    
    .signal.org
    .signal.art
    .signal.tube
    .signal.group
    .signal.link
    .signal.me
    

Copy

### [⁠](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop#stand-alone-deployment)Stand-alone Deployment

This image was designed to run natively within Kasm Workspaces, but it can also be deployed stand-alone and accessed through a web browser.
    
    
    sudo docker run --rm -it --shm-size=512m -p 6901:6901 -e VNC_PW=password kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0
    

Copy

The container is now accessible via a browser : https://IP_OF_SERVER:6901

  * User : kasm_user
  * Password: password



**Please note that some functionality, such as audio, uploads, downloads, and microphone pass-through, is only available when using Kasm Workspaces for orchestration.**

  * 1.18.0-rolling

    * Rolling tags are images that are updated and built nightly to ensure your images are running the latest version.
  * develop

    * The develop tag is for testing and provides no expectation of compatibility.

# KasmVNC - Linux Web Remote Desktop [![](https://5856039.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/5856039/kasmvnc_logo.png) KasmVNC provides remote web-based access to a Desktop or application. While VNC is in the name, KasmVNC differs from other VNC variants such as TigerVNC, RealVNC, and TurboVNC. KasmVNC has broken from the RFB specification which defines VNC, in order to support modern technologies and increase security. KasmVNC is accessed by users from any modern browser and does not support legacy VNC viewer applications. KasmVNC uses a modern YAML based configuration at the server and user level, allowing for ease of management. [Kasm Technologies](https://www.kasmweb.com) developed Kasm Workspaces, the Containerized Streaming Platform. Kasm has open-sourced the Workspace docker images, which include containerized [full desktops and apps](https://github.com/kasmtech/workspaces-images) and [base images](https://github.com/kasmtech/workspaces-core-images) intended for developers to create customized streaming containers. These containers can be used standalone or within the [Kasm Workspaces Platform](https://www.kasmweb.com) which provides a full Enterprise feature set. ## Documentation **Do not use the README from the master branch**, unless you are compiling KasmVNC yourself from the tip of master. Use the documentation for your specific release. \- [KasmVNC Documentation](https://www.kasmweb.com/kasmvnc/docs/latest/index.html) For beta releases prior to version 1.0.0, use the README in this github project on the tagged commit for that release. ## Installation **You must disconnect and reconnect to the server after installation, for the group membership to apply.** ### Debian/Ubuntu/Kali ```sh # Please choose the package for your distro here (under Assets): # https://github.com/kasmtech/KasmVNC/releases wget  sudo apt-get install ./kasmvncserver_*.deb # Add your user to the ssl-cert group sudo adduser $USER ssl-cert ``` ### Oracle 8 ```sh # Please choose the package for your distro here (under Assets): # https://github.com/kasmtech/KasmVNC/releases wget  # Ensure KasmVNC dependencies are available sudo dnf config-manager --set-enabled ol8_codeready_builder sudo dnf install oracle-epel-release-el8 sudo dnf localinstall ./kasmvncserver_*.rpm # Add your user to the kasmvnc-cert group sudo usermod -a -G kasmvnc-cert $USER ``` ## Getting Started The following examples provide basic usage of KasmVNC with the tools provided. For full documentation on all the utilities and the runtime environment, see our [KasmVNC Documentation](https://www.kasmweb.com/kasmvnc/docs/latest/index.html) ```sh # Start a session and be guided to setup a user and select a default desktop environment vncserver # Start a session with the mate desktop environment vncserver -select-de mate # Add a new user with read/write permissions vncpasswd -u my_username -w -r # Tail the logs tail -f ~/.vnc/*.log # Get a list of current sessions with display IDs vncserver -list # Kill the VNC session with display ID :2 vncserver -kill :2 ``` ### Optional systemd auto-start on boot ```sh # Optionally use systemd to start KasmVNC on boot. sudo reboot # Needed for systemd to pick up $USER's ssl-cert or kasmvnc-cert group systemctl --user enable kasmvncserver@:1 # :1 is Xorg DISPLAY number. systemctl --user start kasmvncserver@:1 # You can run multiple KasmVNC instances via systemd by passing a different # DISPLAY number: # systemctl --user enable kasmvncserver@:2 # systemctl --user start kasmvncserver@:2 # systemctl --user enable kasmvncserver@:3 # systemctl --user start kasmvncserver@:3 ``` ## Configuration KasmVNC is configured via YAML based configurations. The server level configuration is at `/etc/kasmvnc/kasmvnc.yaml`. Edits to this file apply to all users. **Direction is correct, but it is not yet safe to execute as-is.** The image/tag choice, VSCodium install, and Traefik HTTPS routing are all sound. However, I found **one high-severity correctness bug** in the Dockerfile, and two items that were proposed but **not actually applied to disk** (dead `Coder` app entry and a leftover code-server script). The "multiuser" requirement is also still unmet — this change is a 1:1 desktop swap, not per-user isolation.

## What I verified

| Check | Result | Evidence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Kasm base tag `kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0` | ✅ Valid | Docker Hub API lists `1.18.0` (multi-arch, active) |

## Findings (by severity)

### 🔴 High — Dockerfile leaves the container running as `root`

The Kasm base image deliberately ends with:

```dockerfile
ENV HOME /home/kasm-user
USER 1000
```

The new Dockerfile does `USER root` to install packages and **never restores `USER 1000`**. The compose file has no `user:` override, so the container starts as `root`.

**Impact:** the desktop session, XDG autostart, and VSCodium resolve home via `getpwuid` → `/root`, not `/home/kasm-user`. This breaks the mounted persistence volumes (`/home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium`, `/home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss`), the desktop shortcut, and the autostart entry — all of which were placed under `/home/kasm-user`.

**Fix:** restore `USER 1000` at the end of the Dockerfile (matches base image).

### 🟠 Medium — `Coder` app entry was never removed from the model

`api/codx/junior/model/workspace.py` on disk **still contains** the `Coder` app:

```python
{"icon": "fa-solid fa-code", "name": "Coder", "path": "/workspace-default/coder/", ...}
```

The compose file already removed the `coder` router, so this tile is now a dead link on fresh installs. The proposed removal was not written.

### 🟠 Medium — dead `custom-services.d/02-coder-init.sh` left behind

This is linuxserver/s6-overlay specific (`with-contenv`, `s6-setuidgid`, `PUID/PGID`, `/config`). The Kasm image does not use it and the compose no longer mounts `custom-services.d`. It should be deleted to avoid confusion (it still references `CODE_SERVER_PORT`).

### 🟡 Low — "multiuser" is not actually implemented

The change replaces the shared webtop desktop with a single shared KasmVNC session. KasmVNC's default is **one X session with concurrent viewers** — mouse/keyboard/clipboard are shared. True per-user isolation (one container per user) was explicitly deferred and is not present. This is fine as a first step, but it does not satisfy "multiuser".

### 🟡 Low — Traefik path-strip edge case (pre-existing)

`replacepathregex` only matches `^/workspace-default/preview/(.*)`, so a bare `/workspace-default/preview` (no trailing slash) would 404. The app entry uses `/workspace-default/preview/index.html`, so the normal flow works. This is the same pattern the working webtop config used, so KasmVNC-behind-this-subpath is proven.

### 🟡 Low — minor items (non-blocking)

- `VNC_PW`/`VNC_RESOLUTION` are set in both `env_file` and `environment` (redundant, harmless).
- The `codium` package ships its own `.desktop` entry (without `--no-sandbox`); the custom `vscodium.desktop` creates a second menu entry. Consider `sed`-ing the package's entry to add `--no-sandbox` instead of adding a duplicate.

### 1. `Dockerfile` — restore the runtime user

<file_change path="codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/Dockerfile" language="dockerfile" change_type="update" encoding="text">
################################################################################
# codx-junior default workspace desktop
#
# Base: kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop — Ubuntu 24.04 desktop streamed by KasmVNC
#       on https://<container>:6901 (user: kasm_user, password: $VNC_PW)
# Adds: VSCodium (https://vscodium.com) from the official apt repository, wired
#       into kasm_user's desktop and started with the session.
#
# Build:
#   docker compose build codx-junior-default
################################################################################
ARG KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE=kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0
FROM ${KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE}

USER root
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]

################################################################################
# VSCodium — official apt repository
# https://vscodium.com/#install-on-debian-ubuntu-debian-derivatives
################################################################################
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg \
    && curl -fsSL https://gitlab.com/paulcarroty/vscodium-deb-rpm-repo/raw/master/pub.gpg \
        | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg \
    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.vscodium.com/debs vscodium main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.list \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends codium \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

################################################################################
# Desktop integration for kasm-user (uid 1000)
#
# --no-sandbox: Electron/Chromium user namespaces are not available in the
# container, the flag is required for VSCodium to start.
################################################################################
RUN printf '%s\n' \
      '[Desktop Entry]' \
      'Type=Application' \
      'Name=VSCodium' \
      'GenericName=Text Editor' \
      'Comment=Code editing. Redefined. (VSCodium)' \
      'Exec=/usr/bin/codium --no-sandbox %F' \
      'Icon=vscodium' \
      'Terminal=false' \
      'Categories=Development;IDE;TextEditor;' \
      'StartupNotify=false' \
      'StartupWMClass=VSCodium' \
      > /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop \
    && mkdir -p /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss/extensions \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && chmod +x /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart/vscodium.desktop \
    && chown -R 1000:0 /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                     /home/kasm-user/.config \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss

# KasmVNC web endpoint (https)
EXPOSE 6901

################################################################################
# Restore the base image's default runtime user.
#
# kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop ends with `USER 1000` / `HOME=/home/kasm-user`.
# Leaving USER root here would run the desktop session as root, so VSCodium
# config, extensions, the desktop shortcut and XDG autostart would resolve to
# /root instead of the mounted /home/kasm-user paths.
################################################################################
USER 1000
</file_change>

- Existing installations keep their persisted `workspaces` settings in `global_settings` — the admin UI/seed must drop the `Coder` app there too; editing `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE` only affects fresh installs.
- "Multiuser" per-user isolation still requires the deferred per-user provisioning work (one container per user with its own KasmVNC session and `PathPrefix('/workspace-default/desktop/<user>')`).

import logging
from pathlib import Path

from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader

from codx.junior.workspaces.model import Workspace
from codx.junior.project.project_discover import find_all_projects
from codx.junior.workspaces.engines.compose import DockerComposeEngine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TEMPLATES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "templates"

AVAILABLE_TEMPLATES = {
    "static-site": "Single container running a web site / dev server (e.g. Vue)",
    "dev-stack": "Sysbox container with systemd + inner Docker for full-stack development",
    "custom": "Empty workspace, admin provides all files",
}


def get_project_mounts(workspace: Workspace) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Resolve host paths for the workspace's projects.

    Only the projects listed in workspace.project_ids are mounted — never
    the whole projects folder. project_ids == ["*"] mounts all projects.
    Projects are identity-mounted (same path inside the container) to match
    the default workspace convention.
    """
    all_projects = find_all_projects() or {}  # Dict[project_id, CODXJuniorSettings]

    if "*" in workspace.project_ids:
        projects = list(all_projects.values())
    else:
        projects = [
            all_projects[pid] for pid in workspace.project_ids
            if pid in all_projects
        ]

    return [
        {
            "project_id": project.project_id,
            "host_path": project.abs_project_path,
            "container_path": project.abs_project_path,
        }
        for project in projects
    ]

def render_template(workspace: Workspace, target_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Render the workspace template into target_dir."""
    if workspace.template == "custom":
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return

    template_dir = TEMPLATES_DIR / workspace.template
    if not template_dir.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown workspace template: {workspace.template}")

    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(template_dir)), keep_trailing_newline=True)
    context = {
        "workspace": workspace,
        "projects": get_project_mounts(workspace),
        "traefik_labels": DockerComposeEngine.traefik_labels,
    }

    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for file in template_dir.rglob("*"):
        if not file.is_file():
            continue
        rel = file.relative_to(template_dir)
        dest = target_dir / str(rel).removesuffix(".j2")
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if file.suffix == ".j2":
            dest.write_text(env.get_template(str(rel)).render(**context))
        else:
            dest.write_bytes(file.read_bytes())
        logger.info("Rendered %s -> %s", rel, dest)

I traced the actual deployed state (compose template, workspace engine, Traefik file-provider config, and the running Docker containers). The workspace is broken for **four concrete reasons**, none of which are the Kasm/VSCodium concept itself — they are routing/config regressions.

### What's actually broken

| # | Problem | Effect |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 1 | **Preview router path mismatch** — router matches `PathPrefix('/workspace-default/desktop')` but the strip middleware strips `^/workspace-default/preview/(.*)` and the app tile points to `/workspace-default/preview/index.html` | `preview` tile → 404 (no router matches `/preview`) |
| 2 | **`coder` route removed entirely** from compose, but the `Coder` app tile still points to `/workspace-default/coder/` | `coder` tile → 404 |
| 3 | **Invalid Traefik `serversTransports` label** — `serversTransports` cannot be created via Docker labels; the backend references a transport that doesn't exist | KasmVNC's self-signed TLS on 6901 would fail TLS verification even if the path matched |
| 4 | **Dockerfile never restores `USER 1000`** — Kasm base image runs as `kasm-user` (uid 1000); leaving `USER root` breaks desktop session/XDG/VSCodium persistence | Desktop starts as root → config/extensions/autostart resolve to `/root` instead of `/home/kasm-user` |

Supporting observations: the new containers are stuck in `Created` (never started), `container_name` has a leftover `-new` suffix from a failed re-create, and `custom-services.d/02-coder-init.sh` is dead linuxserver/s6 config that the Kasm image ignores.

### The "coder shows VSCodium" requirement

VSCodium is a desktop Electron app — it cannot be served in a browser directly. The correct mechanism is VSCodium's built-in **`codium serve-web`** CLI (confirmed against the VS Code CLI source: it supports `--host`, `--port`, `--without-connection-token`, `--accept-server-license-terms`, `--server-base-path`, `--disable-telemetry`, `--server-data-dir`, `--default-folder`).

So the fix makes:
- **`preview`** → KasmVNC Ubuntu desktop (`codium` also auto-starts inside it).
- **`coder`** → `codium serve-web` (VSCodium in the browser) on a separate container using the same image.

### 2.1 Dockerfile — restore runtime user + expose serve-web port

<file_change path="codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/Dockerfile" language="dockerfile" change_type="update" encoding="text">
################################################################################
# codx-junior default workspace desktop
#
# Base: kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop — Ubuntu 24.04 desktop streamed by KasmVNC
#       on https://<container>:6901 (user: kasm_user, password: $VNC_PW)
# Adds: VSCodium (https://vscodium.com) from the official apt repository, wired
#       into kasm_user's desktop and started with the session.
#
# The same image also runs VSCodium's browser server (`codium serve-web`) for
# the "coder" route — see docker-compose.yaml `codx-junior-coder` service.
#
# Build:
#   docker compose build codx-junior-default
################################################################################
ARG KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE=kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0
FROM ${KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE}

USER root
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]

################################################################################
# VSCodium — official apt repository
# https://vscodium.com/#install-on-debian-ubuntu-debian-derivatives
################################################################################
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg \
    && curl -fsSL https://gitlab.com/paulcarroty/vscodium-deb-rpm-repo/raw/master/pub.gpg \
        | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg \
    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.vscodium.com/debs vscodium main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.list \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends codium \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

################################################################################
# Desktop integration for kasm-user (uid 1000)
#
# --no-sandbox: Electron/Chromium user namespaces are not available in the
# container, the flag is required for VSCodium to start.
################################################################################
RUN printf '%s\n' \
      '[Desktop Entry]' \
      'Type=Application' \
      'Name=VSCodium' \
      'GenericName=Text Editor' \
      'Comment=Code editing. Redefined. (VSCodium)' \
      'Exec=/usr/bin/codium --no-sandbox %F' \
      'Icon=vscodium' \
      'Terminal=false' \
      'Categories=Development;IDE;TextEditor;' \
      'StartupNotify=false' \
      'StartupWMClass=VSCodium' \
      > /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop \
    && mkdir -p /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss/extensions \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-server \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && chmod +x /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart/vscodium.desktop \
    && chown -R 1000:0 /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                     /home/kasm-user/.config \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-server

# KasmVNC web endpoint (https)
EXPOSE 6901
# VSCodium browser server (`codium serve-web`)
EXPOSE 9080

################################################################################
# Restore the base image's default runtime user.
#
# kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop ends with `USER 1000` / `HOME=/home/kasm-user`.
# Leaving USER root here would run the desktop session as root, so VSCodium
# config, extensions, the desktop shortcut and XDG autostart would resolve to
# /root instead of the mounted /home/kasm-user paths.
################################################################################
USER 1000
</file_change>

### 2.2 docker-compose.yaml — fix routing, transport, and add coder service

<file_change path="codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/docker-compose.yaml" language="yaml" change_type="update" encoding="text">
services:
  codx-junior-default:
    #####################################################################################
    ##
    ## NOTE: codx-junior-auth@file
    ##
    ## Use codx-junior-auth middleware to secure the workspace endpoints
    #####################################################################################
    # Kasm Ubuntu Noble desktop (KasmVNC) with VSCodium pre-installed, see ./Dockerfile
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: codxjunior/codx-junior-default-workspace:latest
    container_name: codx-junior-default-workspace
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: '512m'
    volumes:
      - /home/codx-junior/codx-junior:/home/codx-junior/codx-junior # TODO: remove
      # Projects volume mapping
      - /home/codx-junior-projects:/home/codx-junior-projects
      # Persist VSCodium settings and extensions across container re-creation
      - codx-junior-desktop-config:/home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium
      - codx-junior-desktop-extensions:/home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss
      # Access docker
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    env_file:
      - ./.workspace.env
    environment:
      - VNC_PW=${VNC_PW:-password}
      - VNC_RESOLUTION=${VNC_RESOLUTION:-1920x1080}
      - CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN=${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true

      #####################################################################################
      ## Desktop (KasmVNC) → https://${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}/workspace-default/preview/
      ##
      ## KasmVNC serves its own self-signed TLS on 6901. Use the file-provider
      ## transport `insecure-skip-verify` (defined in traefik/routes/transports.yaml)
      ## instead of trying to declare a serversTransport via labels (unsupported).
      #####################################################################################
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/workspace-default/preview`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.service=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.middlewares=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-chain,codx-junior-auth
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.server.port=6901
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.serversTransport=insecure-skip-verify@file
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-strip.stripprefix.prefixes=/workspace-default/preview
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-strip.stripprefix.forceSlash=true
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-headers.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Proto=https
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-headers.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Port=443
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-chain.chain.middlewares=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-strip,codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-headers
    networks:
      - codx-junior

  codx-junior-coder:
    #####################################################################################
    ## VSCodium (browser) via `codium serve-web`
    ## → https://${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}/workspace-default/coder/
    ##
    ## serve-web runs with --server-base-path, so assets/websockets resolve under
    ## the prefix. Traefik must NOT strip the path for this service.
    #####################################################################################
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: codxjunior/codx-junior-default-workspace:latest
    container_name: codx-junior-default-workspace-coder
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint: ["/usr/bin/codium"]
    command:
      - serve-web
      - --host
      - 0.0.0.0
      - --port
      - "${CODER_PORT:-9080}"
      - --without-connection-token
      - --accept-server-license-terms
      - --server-base-path
      - /workspace-default/coder
      - --disable-telemetry
      - --server-data-dir
      - /home/kasm-user/.vscode-server
      - --default-folder
      - /home/codx-junior-projects
    volumes:
      - /home/codx-junior-projects:/home/codx-junior-projects
      - codx-junior-coder-data:/home/kasm-user/.vscode-server
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-coder-router.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/workspace-default/coder`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-coder-router.service=codx-junior-default-workspace-coder-service
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-coder-router.middlewares=codx-junior-auth
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-coder-service.loadbalancer.server.port=${CODER_PORT:-9080}
    networks:
      - codx-junior

  codx-junior-docs:
    image: node:22-alpine
    container_name: codx-junior-docs
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /home/codx-junior/codx-junior/docs:/app
    working_dir: /app
    command: sh -c "npm i && npm run docs:dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --base /workspace-default/docs/"
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-router.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/workspace-default/docs`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-router.service=codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-service
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-service.loadbalancer.server.port=5173
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-service.loadbalancer.server.scheme=http
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-router.middlewares=codx-junior-auth
    networks:
      - codx-junior

volumes:
  codx-junior-desktop-config:
  codx-junior-desktop-extensions:
  codx-junior-coder-data:
  codx-junior-projects:
    external: true

networks:
  codx-junior:
    name: codx-junior_default
    external: true
</file_change>

## 4. Notes / caveats

1. **`codium serve-web` first-load download**: `serve-web` fetches the VSCodium web server binary on first request (the container needs outbound internet). Until then it returns a "downloading" page. If your VSCodium CLI cannot reach its update endpoint, the fallback is to point the `Coder` tile at the desktop (where VSCodium already auto-starts) instead of `serve-web` — tell me and I'll adjust.

2. **`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}` interpolation** relies on the environment when `docker compose` runs (the API's workspace manager already exports it). If you run compose manually, export `CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN` first.

3. **`insecure-skip-verify@file`** must stay defined in `traefik/routes/transports.yaml` (it is) — it is what the desktop service now references. The invalid `serversTransports` label was the previous blocker.

4. **Projects write permission**: the Kasm image runs as `kasm-user` (uid 1000) while `/home/codx-junior-projects` is host-owned (uid 1001). Read access works; if users need to *write* projects from inside the desktop, the host projects ownership or the container UID mapping will need a follow-up change — separate from this routing fix.

    ##
    ## Use codx-junior-auth middleware to secure the workspace endpoints
    #####################################################################################
    # Kasm Ubuntu Noble desktop (KasmVNC) with VSCodium pre-installed, see ./Dockerfile
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: codxjunior/codx-junior-default-workspace:latest
    container_name: codx-junior-default-workspace-new
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: '512m'
    volumes:
      - /home/codx-junior/codx-junior:/home/codx-junior/codx-junior # TODO: remove
      # Projects volume mapping
      - /home/codx-junior-projects:/home/codx-junior-projects
      # Persist VSCodium settings and extensions across container re-creation
      - codx-junior-desktop-config:/home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium
      - codx-junior-desktop-extensions:/home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss
      # Access docker
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    env_file:
      - ./.workspace.env
    environment:
      - VNC_PW=${VNC_PW:-password}
      - VNC_RESOLUTION=${VNC_RESOLUTION:-1920x1080}
      - CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN=${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true

      #####################################################################################
      ## Desktop (KasmVNC) → https://${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}/workspace-default/preview/index.html
      ##
      ## KasmVNC exposes its own self-signed certificate on 6901, Traefik must use
      ## https and skip TLS verification for this backend.
      #####################################################################################
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/workspace-default/desktop`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.service=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.server.port=6901
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.serversTransport=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-transport
      - traefik.http.serversTransports.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-transport.insecureSkipVerify=true
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-path.replacepathregex.regex=^/workspace-default/preview/(.*)
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-path.replacepathregex.replacement=/$$1
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.middlewares=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-path,codx-junior-auth
    networks:
      - codx-junior

  codx-junior-docs:

    container_name: codx-junior-docs
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /home/codx-junior/codx-junior/docs:/app
    working_dir: /app

import logging
from pathlib import Path

from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader

from codx.junior.workspaces.model import Workspace
from codx.junior.project.project_discover import find_all_projects
from codx.junior.workspaces.engines.compose import DockerComposeEngine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TEMPLATES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "templates"

AVAILABLE_TEMPLATES = {
    "static-site": "Single container running a web site / dev server (e.g. Vue)",
    "dev-stack": "Sysbox container with systemd + inner Docker for full-stack development",
    "custom": "Empty workspace, admin provides all files",
}


def get_project_mounts(workspace: Workspace) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Resolve host paths for the workspace's projects.

    Only the projects listed in workspace.project_ids are mounted — never
    the whole projects folder. project_ids == ["*"] mounts all projects.
    Projects are identity-mounted (same path inside the container) to match
    the default workspace convention.
    """
    all_projects = find_all_projects() or {}  # Dict[project_id, CODXJuniorSettings]

    if "*" in workspace.project_ids:
        projects = list(all_projects.values())
    else:
        projects = [
            all_projects[pid] for pid in workspace.project_ids
            if pid in all_projects
        ]

    return [
        {
            "project_id": project.project_id,
            "host_path": project.abs_project_path,
            "container_path": project.abs_project_path,
        }
        for project in projects
    ]

def render_template(workspace: Workspace, target_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Render the workspace template into target_dir."""
    if workspace.template == "custom":
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return

    template_dir = TEMPLATES_DIR / workspace.template
    if not template_dir.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown workspace template: {workspace.template}")

    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(template_dir)), keep_trailing_newline=True)
    context = {
        "workspace": workspace,
        "projects": get_project_mounts(workspace),
        "traefik_labels": DockerComposeEngine.traefik_labels,
    }

    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for file in template_dir.rglob("*"):
        if not file.is_file():
            continue
        rel = file.relative_to(template_dir)
        dest = target_dir / str(rel).removesuffix(".j2")
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if file.suffix == ".j2":
            dest.write_text(env.get_template(str(rel)).render(**context))
        else:
            dest.write_bytes(file.read_bytes())
        logger.info("Rendered %s -> %s", rel, dest)

"""
WorkspaceManager — docker-compose based workspace lifecycle manager.

Each workspace lives in its own subdirectory under CODX_JUNIOR_WORKSPACES_FOLDER:

    <workspaces_root>/<workspace.folder_path>/
        docker-compose.yaml   ← user-managed, defines all services
        .env                  ← optional, injected into compose
        Dockerfile            ← optional, if building custom images
        ...

Traefik integration
-------------------
Services in docker-compose.yaml must declare Traefik labels themselves
OR use external URLs which are handled by the HTTP provider in traefik.py.

For container-port apps, users add labels like:
    - "traefik.enable=true"
    - "traefik.http.routers.<id>.rule=PathPrefix(`/ws/<slug>/<app>`)"
    - "traefik.http.services.<id>.loadbalancer.server.port=<port>"

This manager exposes helpers to inject those labels automatically when
workspace.apps is populated and the service name matches the app.
"""

import logging
import os
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from codx.junior.globals import CODX_JUNIOR_WORKSPACES_FOLDER
from codx.junior.global_settings import read_global_settings, write_global_settings, write_settings_section
from codx.junior.workspaces.model import Workspace, WorkspaceStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN", "localhost")


class WorkspaceEngine:
    """Low-level filesystem helpers for a workspace directory."""

    def __init__(self, workspaces_root: Path):
        self.workspaces_root = workspaces_root

    def workspace_dir(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:
        """Absolute path to the workspace folder."""
        return (self.workspaces_root / workspace.folder_path).resolve()

    def compose_file(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:
        return self.workspace_dir(workspace) / "docker-compose.yaml"

    def ensure_dir(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:
        d = self.workspace_dir(workspace)
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return d

    def destroy(self, workspace: Workspace) -> None:
        """Remove the workspace directory entirely."""
        d = self.workspace_dir(workspace)
        if d.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(d)
            logger.info("Removed workspace directory: %s", d)


class WorkspaceManager:
    """
    Manages workspace lifecycle using docker-compose.

    Each workspace is a folder containing a docker-compose.yaml and any
    support files (.env, Dockerfile, scripts, …).  Users are responsible
    for the content of those files; this manager only orchestrates
    start / stop / status / logs via the docker compose CLI.
    """

    def __init__(self, settings=None):
        # settings parameter kept for API compatibility; manager is global-settings-based
        self._workspaces_root = Path(CODX_JUNIOR_WORKSPACES_FOLDER)
        self._workspaces_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.engine = WorkspaceEngine(self._workspaces_root)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Persistence helpers (read / write global settings)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _load_all(self) -> List[Workspace]:
        return read_global_settings().workspaces or []

    def _save_all(self, workspaces: List[Workspace]) -> None:
        write_settings_section("workspaces", [w.dict() for w in workspaces])

    def _save_one(self, workspace: Workspace) -> None:
        all_ws = self._load_all()
        updated = [workspace if w.id == workspace.id else w for w in all_ws]
        if workspace.id not in {w.id for w in all_ws}:
            updated = all_ws + [workspace]
        self._save_all(updated)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CRUD

# kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop repository overview

**Kasm Workspaces is a docker container streaming platform for delivering browser-based access to desktops, applications, and web services.**

### [⁠](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop#get-started)Get Started

Try out our no-cost Community Edition: [Download⁠](https://kasm.com/downloads).

Our Kasm Workspaces team has open-sourced our library of images ([Info⁠](https://docs.kasm.com/docs/how-to/workspaces-sessions/container-workspace/custom-images) & [Source Code⁠](https://github.com/kasmtech/workspaces-images)).

The web-native rendering is powered by our open-source project: [KasmVNC⁠](https://github.com/kasmtech/KasmVNC).

### [⁠](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop#about-this-image)About This Image

This Image contains a browser-accessible Ubuntu Noble Desktop with various productivity and development apps installed.

![Screenshot](https://5856039.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/5856039/dockerhub/image-screenshots/ubuntu_jammy_desktop.png)

This image contains the Signal app pre-installed. Signal enforces strict security rules that block network access if it detects SSL inspection (MitM). To ensure Signal functions correctly when **WebFilter** is enabled, you must add these domains to the **SSL Bypass Domains** list in your **WebFilter configuration** : (Notice the preceding dot (.) that ensures all subdomains are also bypassed)
    
    
    .signal.org
    .signal.art
    .signal.tube
    .signal.group
    .signal.link
    .signal.me
    

Copy

### [⁠](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop#stand-alone-deployment)Stand-alone Deployment

This image was designed to run natively within Kasm Workspaces, but it can also be deployed stand-alone and accessed through a web browser.
    
    
    sudo docker run --rm -it --shm-size=512m -p 6901:6901 -e VNC_PW=password kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0
    

Copy

The container is now accessible via a browser : https://IP_OF_SERVER:6901

  * User : kasm_user
  * Password: password



**Please note that some functionality, such as audio, uploads, downloads, and microphone pass-through, is only available when using Kasm Workspaces for orchestration.**

Administrators may wish to run the application on another port so that the reverse proxy can run on port 443. During the installation pass the **-L** flag to choose a different port. e.g `sudo bash kasm_release/install.sh -L 8443` Users will now access Kasm Workspaces via the defined port **https://kasm.server:8443** ## Example Nginx Config Below is an example Nginx config with the appropriate settings for Kasm annotated. ### 2.2 `Dockerfile` — restore runtime user + prepare coder data dir

<file_change path="codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/Dockerfile" language="dockerfile" change_type="update" encoding="text">
################################################################################
# codx-junior default workspace desktop
#
# Base: kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop — Ubuntu 24.04 desktop streamed by KasmVNC
#       on https://<container>:6901 (user: kasm_user, password: $VNC_PW)
# Adds: VSCodium (https://vscodium.com) from the official apt repository, wired
#       into kasm_user's desktop and started with the session.
#
# The same image also runs VSCodium's browser server (`codium serve-web`) for
# the "coder" route — see docker-compose.yaml `codx-junior-coder` service.
#
# Build:
#   docker compose build codx-junior-default
################################################################################
ARG KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE=kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0
FROM ${KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE}

USER root
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]

################################################################################
# VSCodium — official apt repository
# https://vscodium.com/#install-on-debian-ubuntu-debian-derivatives
################################################################################
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg \
    && curl -fsSL https://gitlab.com/paulcarroty/vscodium-deb-rpm-repo/raw/master/pub.gpg \
        | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg \
    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.vscodium.com/debs vscodium main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.list \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends codium \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

################################################################################
# Desktop integration for kasm-user (uid 1000)
#
# --no-sandbox: Electron/Chromium user namespaces are not available in the
# container, the flag is required for VSCodium to start.
################################################################################
RUN printf '%s\n' \
      '[Desktop Entry]' \
      'Type=Application' \
      'Name=VSCodium' \
      'GenericName=Text Editor' \
      'Comment=Code editing. Redefined. (VSCodium)' \
      'Exec=/usr/bin/codium --no-sandbox %F' \
      'Icon=vscodium' \
      'Terminal=false' \
      'Categories=Development;IDE;TextEditor;' \
      'StartupNotify=false' \
      'StartupWMClass=VSCodium' \
      > /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop \
    && mkdir -p /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss/extensions \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-server \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && chmod +x /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart/vscodium.desktop \
    && chown -R 1000:0 /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                     /home/kasm-user/.config \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-server

# KasmVNC web endpoint (https)
EXPOSE 6901
# VSCodium browser server (`codium serve-web`)
EXPOSE 9080

################################################################################
# Restore the base image's default runtime user.
#
# kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop ends with `USER 1000` / `HOME=/home/kasm-user`.
# Leaving USER root here would run the desktop session as root, so VSCodium
# config, extensions, the desktop shortcut and XDG autostart would resolve to
# /root instead of the mounted /home/kasm-user paths.
################################################################################
USER 1000
</file_change>

services:
  codx-junior-default:
    #####################################################################################
    ##
    ## NOTE: codx-junior-auth@file
    ##
    ## Use codx-junior-auth middleware to secure the workspace endpoints
    #####################################################################################
    # Kasm Ubuntu Noble desktop (KasmVNC) with VSCodium pre-installed, see ./Dockerfile
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: codxjunior/codx-junior-default-workspace:latest
    container_name: codx-junior-default-workspace-new
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: '512m'
    volumes:
      - /home/codx-junior/codx-junior:/home/codx-junior/codx-junior # TODO: remove
      # Projects volume mapping
      - /home/codx-junior-projects:/home/codx-junior-projects
      # Persist VSCodium settings and extensions across container re-creation
      - codx-junior-desktop-config:/home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium
      - codx-junior-desktop-extensions:/home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss
      # Access docker
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    env_file:
      - ./.workspace.env
    environment:
      - VNC_PW=${VNC_PW:-password}
      - VNC_RESOLUTION=${VNC_RESOLUTION:-1920x1080}
      - CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN=${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true

      #####################################################################################
      ## Desktop (KasmVNC) → https://${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}/workspace-default/preview/index.html
      ##
      ## KasmVNC exposes its own self-signed certificate on 6901, Traefik must use
      ## https and skip TLS verification for this backend.
      #####################################################################################
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/workspace-default/desktop`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.service=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.server.port=6901
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-service.loadbalancer.serversTransport=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-transport
      - traefik.http.serversTransports.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-transport.insecureSkipVerify=true
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-path.replacepathregex.regex=^/workspace-default/preview/(.*)
      - traefik.http.middlewares.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-path.replacepathregex.replacement=/$$1
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-router.middlewares=codx-junior-default-workspace-desktop-path,codx-junior-auth
    networks:
      - codx-junior

  codx-junior-docs:
    image: node:22-alpine
    container_name: codx-junior-docs
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /home/codx-junior/codx-junior/docs:/app
    working_dir: /app
    command: sh -c "npm i && npm run docs:dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --base /workspace-default/docs/"
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-router.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/workspace-default/docs`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-router.service=codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-service
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-service.loadbalancer.server.port=5173
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-service.loadbalancer.server.scheme=http
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-default-workspace-docs-router.middlewares=codx-junior-auth
    networks:
      - co

    labels:

      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/codx-localai/app`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai.entrypoints=web
      
      # HTTPS Router (for standalone with SSL)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai-secure.rule=Host(`${CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN}`) && PathPrefix(`/codx-localai/app`)
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai-secure.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai-secure.tls.certresolver=sslresolver

      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai.service=codx-junior-localai-service
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai-secure.service=codx-junior-localai-service
      - traefik.http.services.codx-junior-localai-service.loadbalancer.server.port=8080

      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai.middlewares=localai-headers,codx-junior-auth
      - traefik.http.routers.codx-junior-localai-secure.middlewares=localai-headers,codx-junior-auth

################################################################################
# codx-junior default workspace desktop
#
# Base: kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop — Ubuntu 24.04 desktop streamed by KasmVNC
#       on https://<container>:6901 (user: kasm_user, password: $VNC_PW)
# Adds: VSCodium (https://vscodium.com) from the official apt repository, wired
#       into kasm_user's desktop and started with the session.
#
# The same image also runs VSCodium's browser server (`codium serve-web`) for
# the "coder" route — see docker-compose.yaml `codx-junior-coder` service.
#
# Build:
#   docker compose build codx-junior-default
################################################################################
ARG KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE=kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop:1.18.0
FROM ${KASM_DESKTOP_IMAGE}

USER root
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]

################################################################################
# VSCodium — official apt repository
# https://vscodium.com/#install-on-debian-ubuntu-debian-derivatives
################################################################################
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg \
    && curl -fsSL https://gitlab.com/paulcarroty/vscodium-deb-rpm-repo/raw/master/pub.gpg \
        | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg \
    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.vscodium.com/debs vscodium main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.list \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends codium \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

################################################################################
# Desktop integration for kasm-user (uid 1000)
#
# --no-sandbox: Electron/Chromium user namespaces are not available in the
# container, the flag is required for VSCodium to start.
################################################################################
RUN printf '%s\n' \
      '[Desktop Entry]' \
      'Type=Application' \
      'Name=VSCodium' \
      'GenericName=Text Editor' \
      'Comment=Code editing. Redefined. (VSCodium)' \
      'Exec=/usr/bin/codium --no-sandbox %F' \
      'Icon=vscodium' \
      'Terminal=false' \
      'Categories=Development;IDE;TextEditor;' \
      'StartupNotify=false' \
      'StartupWMClass=VSCodium' \
      > /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop \
    && mkdir -p /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart \
                /home/kasm-user/.config/VSCodium \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss/extensions \
                /home/kasm-user/.vscode-server \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && chmod +x /home/kasm-user/Desktop/vscodium.desktop \
    && cp /usr/share/applications/vscodium.desktop /home/kasm-user/.config/autostart/vscodium.desktop \
    && chown -R 1000:0 /home/kasm-user/Desktop \
                     /home/kasm-user/.config \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-oss \
                     /home/kasm-user/.vscode-server

# KasmVNC web endpoint (https)
EXPOSE 6901
# VSCodium browser server (`codium serve-web`)
EXPOSE 9080

################################################################################
# Restore the base image's default runtime user.
#
# kasmweb/ubuntu-noble-desktop ends with `USER 1000` / `HOME=/home/kasm-user`.
# Leaving USER root here would run the desktop session as root, so VSCodium
# config, extensions, the desktop shortcut and XDG autostart would resolve to
# /root instead of the mounted /home/kasm-user paths.
################################################################################
USER 1000
</file_change>

"""
WorkspaceManager — docker-compose based workspace lifecycle manager.

Each workspace lives in its own subdirectory under CODX_JUNIOR_WORKSPACES_FOLDER:

    <workspaces_root>/<workspace.folder_path>/
        docker-compose.yaml   ← user-managed, defines all services
        .env                  ← optional, injected into compose
        Dockerfile            ← optional, if building custom images
        ...

Traefik integration
-------------------
Services in docker-compose.yaml must declare Traefik labels themselves
OR use external URLs which are handled by the HTTP provider in traefik.py.

For container-port apps, users add labels like:
    - "traefik.enable=true"
    - "traefik.http.routers.<id>.rule=PathPrefix(`/ws/<slug>/<app>`)"
    - "traefik.http.services.<id>.loadbalancer.server.port=<port>"

This manager exposes helpers to inject those labels automatically when
workspace.apps is populated and the service name matches the app.
"""

import logging
import os
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from codx.junior.globals import CODX_JUNIOR_WORKSPACES_FOLDER
from codx.junior.global_settings import read_global_settings, write_global_settings, write_settings_section
from codx.junior.workspaces.model import Workspace, WorkspaceStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("CODX_JUNIOR_DOMAIN", "localhost")


class WorkspaceEngine:
    """Low-level filesystem helpers for a workspace directory."""

    def __init__(self, workspaces_root: Path):
        self.workspaces_root = workspaces_root

    def workspace_dir(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:
        """Absolute path to the workspace folder."""
        return (self.workspaces_root / workspace.folder_path).resolve()

    def compose_file(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:
        return self.workspace_dir(workspace) / "docker-compose.yaml"

    def ensure_dir(self, workspace: Workspace) -> Path:
        d = self.workspace_dir(workspace)
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return d

    def destroy(self, workspace: Workspace) -> None:
        """Remove the workspace directory entirely."""
        d = self.workspace_dir(workspace)
        if d.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(d)
            logger.info("Removed workspace directory: %s", d)


class WorkspaceManager:
    """
    Manages workspace lifecycle using docker-compose.

    Each workspace is a folder containing a docker-compose.yaml and any
    support files (.env, Dockerfile, scripts, …).  Users are responsible
    for the content of those files; this manager only orchestrates
    start / stop / status / logs via the docker compose CLI.
    """

    def __init__(self, settings=None):
        # settings parameter kept for API compatibility; manager is global-settings-based
        self._workspaces_root = Path(CODX_JUNIOR_WORKSPACES_FOLDER)
        self._workspaces_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.engine = WorkspaceEngine(self._workspaces_root)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Persistence helpers (read / write global settings)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _load_all(self) -> List[Workspace]:
        return read_global_settings().workspaces or []

    def _save_all(self, workspaces: List[Workspace]) -> None:
        write_settings_section("workspaces", [w.dict() for w in workspaces])

    def _save_one(self, workspace: Workspace) -> None:
        all_ws = self._load_all()
        updated = [workspace if w.id == workspace.id else w for w in all_ws]
        if workspace.id not in {w.id for w in all_ws}:
            updated = all_ws + [workspace]
        self._save_all(updated)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CRUD

2. The stuck `Created` container still has the **old broken labels** (`Host(``) && PathPrefix('/workspace-default/desktop')`, invalid `serversTransports`, `User: root`), so it was never recreated with the fixed compose.
3. Traefik runs from a different host path (`/home/codx-junior/codx-junior/...`) and its HTTP provider is `http://gbrian.codxjunior.com:19980/api/traefik/config`.

I must verify that the `codx-junior-auth` middleware and `insecure-skip-verify@file` transport actually exist before redeploying. Let me read the Traefik config from both paths.Traefik's file provider confirms `insecure-skip-verify@file` exists. Now I need to locate `codx-junior-auth` middleware (likely served by the API's HTTP provider) and understand the workspace deployment mechanism.The HTTP provider endpoint isn't reachable from the host. Let me find where `codx-junior-auth` is defined in the API code and how the workspace engine actually deploys containers.The search tool is returning noise. Let me understand the deployment mechanism directly: inspect the API container (which likely owns workspace orchestration) and read the project config.Now I have the complete picture. Key confirmations:
- `codx-junior-auth` middleware ✅ exists (defined on the API container's Docker labels).
- `insecure-skip-verify@file` transport ✅ exists (Traefik file provider).
- The current `codxjunior/codx-junior-default-workspace:latest` image is the **old build** (`User: root`, no `EXPOSE 9080`), and the stuck `Created` container still carries the old broken labels.

Let me test the compose tool's behavior to see how/where it executes.The compose tool is anchored to the project root. I confirmed the key Traefik pieces exist (`codx-junior-auth` middleware ✅, `insecure-skip-verify@file` transport ✅). I need to bridge the workspace compose into the project root so the tool can run it. Let me verify the `include` directive semantics before writing the bridge file.I have everything I need. The `docker_compose_service` tool is anchored to the project root (`/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior`), which has no compose file. I'll create a thin bridge compose at the root that includes the workspace compose (pinned to the original project name so `--remove-orphans` cleans only the stale workspace containers, not the main stack). I'll also remove a dead external volume in the workspace compose that would otherwise make `up` fail.

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking

**Core requirements**
- Run the workspace `docker-compose.yaml` and test that `preview` (Ubuntu desktop) and `coder` (VSCodium) work.
- Fix and redeploy until it works.

**Verified facts**
| Fact | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| `codx-junior-auth` middleware | ✅ defined on API container Docker labels (`forwardAuth` → `http://codx-junior-api:19980/api/forward-auth`) |
| `insecure-skip-verify@file` transport | ✅ defined in `traefik/routes/transports.yaml` |
| Workspace compose (on disk) | ✅ has fixed desktop (`stripprefix` + `insecure-skip-verify@file`) + `coder` (`codium serve-web`) services |
| Dockerfile | ✅ `USER 1000`, `EXPOSE 9080`, `.vscode-server` |
| Current image `codxjunior/codx-junior-default-workspace:latest` | ❌ old build (`User: root`) — must rebuild |
| Stuck containers | ❌ 2× `Created` + 2× `Exited` with old broken labels |
| Compose tool anchor | runs from project root; no compose file there yet |

**Plan**
1. Add root bridge compose (`name: codx-junior-workspace-default` + `include` of workspace compose).
2. Remove dead `codx-junior-projects` external volume from workspace compose (unused → would fail `up`).
3. `docker compose up --build --remove-orphans` via the tool.
4. Inspect logs + HTTP-test both routes; iterate on failures.

## 2. File changes

### 2.1 Root bridge compose (create)

<file_change path="docker-compose.yaml" language="yaml" change_type="new" encoding="text">
# codx-junior workspace orchestration bridge
#
# The docker-compose tooling for this repository is anchored to the project
# root, while the default workspace compose lives at:
#   codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/
#
# This file includes that workspace compose into the root project so that
# `docker compose up --build` builds the desktop image and recreates the
# workspace containers. The project name is pinned to keep the workspace
# isolated from the main `codx-junior` stack (so --remove-orphans never
# touches the main traefik/api/milvus containers).
name: codx-junior-workspace-default

include:
  - path: codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-default/docker-compose.yaml
</file_change>
